# Fixtures for `xdr`

Files made for whiff's tests, CC0-1.0, for the fictitious Saltmere Harbour. Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/gaps5f.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `saltmere-gauge.xdr` | a gauge record packed with Python xdrlib (RFC 4506) | CC0-1.0 |
| `saltmere-gauge-base64.xdr` | the same record as base64 text | CC0-1.0 |
| `saltmere-nfs-call.xdr` | a record-marked ONC RPC call, NFS v3 GETATTR (RFC 5531), packed with xdrlib | CC0-1.0 |
